- Music: the cover of a YouTube song no longer shows only its top strip (a cover cut half way while it downloaded was kept for a day; it is kept only when whole now, at a bigger size, without the black bars of video pictures).
- Music: while a YouTube song plays, the count under the title counts the songs of its mix, not the songs of the phone.
- Music, YouTube Music search: the artists that fit the search show as round pictures; an artist opens with Play artist (every song of theirs) and their albums (each opens with its songs).
- Video: the subtitle size follows the screen's turn at once (sideways it showed the upright size until the phone was turned again).
- Video: brightness on the left side, volume on the right; the middle fifth is free of them and a pull down there (and Back) sends the video to the mini player over the app, with the library in sight under it (not the system's picture in picture).
- Video: the Next episode button comes in the last 20 seconds of an episode (it came 90 seconds before the end) and stays up for 20 seconds (5 before).
- Code editor: the ground stays AMOLED black (the grammar's theme put its grey back once it loaded); a ≡ button opens the project panel over the whole left side (the folder of the file as a tree, folders open in place, a tap opens a file, one folder up); Pulse AI in the editor (the ✦ tool): say what to change, it rewrites the selection or the whole file and Apply puts it in (Undo takes it back).
- Code editor: a folder or a zip (opened into Documents/Pulse/Code/projects) can be the project; sideways the project tree stays beside the editor; the files opened from it are tabs under the title (× closes one); the ≡ menu of Code's home is the whole left side with the project tree.
- Code editor, Pulse AI: no need to select a part of a long file any more: the model gets the part the request is about and answers with search / replace edits that are put where they match.
